document.title: Parts as a step action, a replaces hint in the digest, no group-count size hint
document.summary: The digest pairs an added file with the deleted file of the same name and keeps both out of the mechanical draft and the directory collapse; the skill names each independent story as a part in step 3 and drops the sentence tying small reviews to a group count.
document.why: [The graded eval on main failed the parts and groups minimums of a mixed PR in every skill version, and sized a schema change small; the fix had to be general rules, not tailoring to those PRs](source:s1).

sources.label: Claude Code session · Oct 2026
sources.gist: Máté asked whether the two failing eval cases could be improved without tailoring the skill to those PRs, noting the expectations might be off, then asked for the three proposed changes and a measurement.

sources.label: Digest: a new file that replaces a deleted one is not a move
sources.gist: An added file whose name matches exactly one deleted file, with no rename detected, prints a replaces hint; the draft puts it in change, the collapse leaves it out, validate fails a directory ref that holds it.

sources.label: Skill: name each story as a part in step 3; drop the group-count size hint
sources.gist: The parts rule lived in reference text and fired in under a third of runs on a mixed PR; the small-review group-count sentence reads backwards from a group count to a size.

sources.label: Digest: the deleted side of a replacement is not a move either
sources.gist: The first round left the deleted goldens inside the directory ref and the grader flagged them; the deleted file now prints replaced by and leaves the collapse too.

parts.name: Replaces hint
parts.summary: A new file that stands in for a deleted one is a new version, not a move, in the digest, the draft, and validate.

parts.name: Skill steps
parts.summary: Step 3 names the stories as parts with its own Done, and the size rule no longer mentions a group count.

groups.title: A replaced file and its replacement are not mechanical
groups.why: [Three regenerated goldens printed as added, generated, inside a collapsed snapshot directory, so no run pulled them out of the mechanical group](source:s2); [the deleted originals had to follow](source:s4).
groups.summary: `markReplaces` in `digest.ts` pairs an added file with the one deleted file of the same basename when git found no rename, `isMechanicalFile` says neither side is mechanical, so `pregroup` in `commands.ts` lists both in the change group, `mechanicalDirs` leaves them out of the directory collapse, and `dirRefErrors` in `coverage.ts` fails a directory ref that still holds one.
lookFor: Subtle: the pair needs exactly one deleted file with that basename; two deleted `index.ts` files leave every added `index.ts` unmarked, and those files count as mechanical and collapse as before.

The digest line for the pair reads `replaces <old>, not a move` and `replaced by <new>, not a move`; with the pair out of `listed`, a snapshot folder of pure renames still collapses to one `dir/` line.

groups.title: Step 3 names the stories; the size rule loses its group count
groups.why: [The parts rule sat in Grouping rules and the step-4 Done and fired in under a third of the runs on a mixed PR, and a sentence that tied trivial and small to one to three groups invited reading a group count as a size](source:s3).
groups.summary: Step 3 of `skills-next/comprehende/SKILL.md` adds one action, name each story that could have been its own PR and give it a `part`, with a Done that checks it; step 2 tells the reader to trust the new `replaces` hint; the Grouping rules size bullet drops its group-count sentence; the `.agents` copy repeats the same four lines.

commits.subject: Digest: the deleted side of a replacement is not a move either
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
The first round moved the three new goldens out of the snapshot directory ref, and the grader then flagged their deleted counterparts left inside it. The deleted file prints 'replaced by <new>, not a move', stays out of the collapse and the mechanical group, and the skill reads both with their story.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: Skill: name each story as a part in step 3; drop the group-count size hint
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
The parts rule lived in Grouping rules and the step-4 Done, and fired in under a third of the runs on a mixed PR. Step 3 now names the stories as an action with its own Done. The sentence tying trivial and small to one to three groups is gone; it reads backwards from a group count to a size.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: Digest: a new file that replaces a deleted one is not a move
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
An added file whose name matches exactly one deleted file, with no rename detected, prints 'replaces <old>, not a move'. The draft puts it in the change group, the directory collapse leaves it out, and validate fails a directory ref that holds it.
